questions.q_en: How many different arrangements of the word PRESUMPTUOUS are possible?
questions.solution_en:
In the word PRESUMPTUOUS, there are 12 letters => 2P, 2S, 3U are repeated.

Total number of ways = 12!/(2! * 2! * 3!) = 55*9!

questions.q_en: If we add 1 to the twice of the denominator of a fraction then we will get 1/5. If we subtract 1 from numerator and add 1 to denominator then we will get 1/4. What is the original fraction?
questions.solution_en:
Let the fraction = m/n

According to the 1st condition; m/(2n+1) = 1/5

=>5m = 2n + 1

=> 5m - 2n = 1 ... (1)

According to the 2nd condition; (m-1)/(n+ 1) = 1/4

=>4m - 4 = n +1

=> 4m - n = 5 ...(2)

Solving (1) and (2) we will get; m = 3 and n = 7

Hence the original fraction = m/n = 3/7

questions.q_en: A can do 3/4th of the work in 27 days, B can do 60% of the work in 96/5 days, and C can do 1/4th of the work in 12 days. Find the time taken by them together to do the same work.
questions.solution_en:
A can do the total work in = 27 * 4/3 = 36 days

B can do the total work in = 96/5 * 60/100 = 32 days

C can do the total work in = 12 * 4 = 48 days

The total work = L.C.M of 36, 32, 48 = 288 days

The efficiency = total work/ total time taken

The efficiency of A = 288/ 36 = 8

The efficiency of B = 288 / 32 = 9

The efficiency of C = 288/ 48 = 6

Time = total work/ total efficiency

Time = 288/ (8 + 9 + 6) = 288/ 23 days

questions.q_en: 28 women can complete a piece of work in 35 days while 60 boys can do the same work in 72 days and 20 girls can complete the same work in 80 days. In how many days the whole work can get completed by 49 women, 54 boys and 25 girls?
questions.solution_en:
Part of work done by 49 women, 54 boys and 25 girls in 1 day = 49/(28 * 35) + 54/(60 * 72) + 25/(20 * 80) = 5/64

So, 49 women, 54 boys and 25 girls together can complete the whole work in = 64/5 = 12.8 days

questions.q_en: A person can hit a target 5 times out of 8 shots. If he fires 10 shots, what is the probability that he will hit the target twice?
questions.solution_en:
Probability of hitting the target P(H) = 5/8

Probability of not hitting the target P(H') = 1 - 5/8 = 3/8

If the person hit the target twice then he will not hit exactly 8 shots.

Probability that he will hit the target twice = 10C2 * [P(H)]2 * [P(H')]8

= (10*9/2) * (5/8)2 * (3/8)8

= 45 * 25 * 38/810

= (1125*38)/810

questions.q_en: A and B are two prime numbers such that A > B and their LCM is 209. The value of B2 - A is:
questions.solution_en:
Since A and B are two prime numbers which means their HCF will be 1.

Hence, product of two prime numbers will be equal to LCM.

A * B = 209

A * B = 19 * 11

After comparing:

A = 19

B = 11

Now,

B2 - A

= 112 - 19

= 102

Let pipe A turned off after 'x' minutes

questions.q_en: A person invested a certain amount in two different schemes equally at a 25% rate of interest and a 20% rate of interest. If the total simple interest received from both schemes after three years is Rs.8100 then find the total principal amount invested in both schemes.
questions.solution_en:
Let the principal amount invested in each scheme be Rs. X.

S.I = P * R * T/100

8100 = X * 25 * 3/100 + X * 20 * 3/100

75X + 60X = 810000

X = 6000

Hence, the required value = 6000 * 2 = Rs. 12000

questions.q_en: Container I and Container II have milk and water in the ratio of 4: 5 and 8: 3 respectively. In what ratio Container I and Container II should be mixed to get a new mixture in which milk and water are in the ratio of 9: 11?
questions.solution_en:
Part of milk in container I = 4/9

Part of milk in container II = 8/11

Part of milk in the final mixture = 9/20

By the rule of alligation:

Ratio in which mixture from containers I and II are mixed = (8/11 - 9/20): (9/20 - 4/9)

= (160 - 99)/220: (81 - 80)/180

= (61/220): (1/180)

= (61 * 180): 220

= 549: 11

Height = 216/ (2 * 36) = 3 m
